confidence_notes: I based the food and coffee prices on web searches of cost-of-living sites and travel guides. The sources disagree. One gives a mid-range meal for two at about $20, while another gives about $47 for a mid-range meal. Tourist-area prices in the medina run 20-30% higher, and some sources report price rises since late 2024. Beer is drawn from local draft or pint figures of about $3-4.70. Alcohol is only sold at licensed venues, so prices vary a lot. The cocktail and wine prices are the least certain. Wine uses one reviewer's 60 MAD large glass. Cocktails sit between standard bars at about 55 MAD and rooftop bars at about 110 MAD or more, adjusted against the beer price. No source gave a reliable per-glass average. Accommodation prices are my own estimates for peak season in July 2026, without searching. Essaouira's lodging is mostly riads and guesthouses, so the line between a 1-star room and a private hostel room is unclear.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Moroccan tourist towns, especially Marrakech's medina and Agadir or Taghazout. Essaouira's restaurants are slightly cheaper than Marrakech's, but in summer its tourist-area and licensed-venue prices are similar.
